Review README.md and /src files and update this overview accordingly.
.NET 10.0 (`net10.0`), latest C#, nullable/implicit usings enabled, warnings as errors. Central package management: versions only in [Directory.Packages.props](Directory.Packages.props); projects omit versions. Settings inherit [Directory.Build.props](Directory.Build.props); Warning 1591 suppressed. Use file-scoped namespaces, Allman braces, 2-space CRLF UTF-8 BOM; `var`, `_camelCase`, PascalCase constants, `I` interfaces, `Async`; primary constructors assign readonly fields. Run `dotnet format`.
Never hardcode sensitive information in source code
Avoid logging sensitive information
Use HTTPS for all communications
Validate and sanitize all user inputs
Use parameterized queries or ORM features to prevent SQL injection
Use `xUnit` for all tests
Do not name test classes with "Tests" suffix; do use "Tests" suffix for folder names if needed
dotnet run --project src/YourProject/YourProject.csproj
Use DI, focused methods/classes, async I/O, OWASP, guards/FluentValidation, suitable HTTP statuses, DTOs, REPR/FastEndpoints, DDD. Production in `src/`, tests in `tests/`; tests use xUnit, AAA, Shouldly, NSubstitute. Use Markdown documentation.
